title: 第一卷 第11章 请李寒舟出手第一卷 第12章 李寒舟的储物袋
slug: 师叔你的法宝太不正经了
content_zh:
;;
“这是家父的请帖。”
叶紫樱从腰间拿出一个小布袋，然后手掌从布袋上轻轻划过，便有一张请帖出现在手里。
“储物袋？”李寒舟眼热了。
这东西非常方便，属于后天灵宝的一种，可以将东西存放到储物空间之中。
李寒舟也很想要，决定之后买材料自己做一个。
“好，既然叶城主有请，那我就恭敬不如从命了。”李寒舟接过请帖笑着说。
不管怎么说，人家毕竟刚帮自己还了赌债，拿人手短，不去也不好。
另外李寒舟也想看看这位城主找自己有什么事情。
说不定还能得到点好处呢。
“请前辈上车。”
叶云和叶紫樱将李寒舟给请上了马车，然后便奔着城主府去了。
“不知道前辈出自何门何派？”叶紫樱在车上恭敬的说道：“说不定前辈和我上清宗的前辈也有一定的渊源呢。”
李寒舟完全不认识上清宗的人，但是也知道上清宗乃是大门大派。
“我来自长生观。”李寒舟也是实话实说。
叶紫樱回忆了一下，记忆中并不认识这么个地方。
长生观实在是太小了，三流宗门之中都是末尾的排行，叶紫樱实在是没听说过。
“前辈真是低调，如此修为，竟然不显山不露水，就连宗门都如此隐秘。”叶紫樱心中想着。
“原来是长生观的前辈，久仰久仰。”叶紫樱客套了两句。
马车很快就进了城主府。

李寒舟掀开车帘向外看去，城主府中如此华丽，和自己的长生观比起来，自己的长生观真是连狗窝都不如啊。
自己一定要好好赚钱，然后将长生观好好的装修一下才行。
“爹，前辈来了！”
叶云连忙喊着。
“多大的人了，还如此咋咋呼呼的，让前辈看笑话！”叶青北走了出来，先是责备了叶云一句，然后来到马车的面前，恭敬一拜：“叶青北拜见前辈。”
“叶城主客气了。”
李寒舟走出来打量着眼前的叶青北，从叶青北的身上并未感受到强者的气息。
能在白云城中当上一城之主，在神阙国中也必定是一方诸侯，但是李寒舟的神魂扫了一下整个城主府，却发现这城主府中并未有什么高手存在。
这倒是有些奇怪。
堂堂一方城主，府中一个高手都没有？
难怪之前血煞之气那么重。
“前辈请进。”
“来人，上茶。”
叶青北热情的招呼着李寒舟。
“感谢前辈的救命之恩，昨日若是没有前辈赐予的神符，我叶青北的命恐怕都要交代在这里了。”叶青北笑呵呵的说。
“客气。”
李寒舟听到这话，也只是点点头，并未深问。
因为李寒舟知道，能让一方城主殒命的，肯定涉及到很复杂的内情，李寒舟可不想参与到这样的事情中来，只是敷衍的答应了一句之后就开始品茶。
茶叶倒是不错，比起长生观里的茶叶要好上不少。
“听闻如今道门很少插手江湖事。”叶青北此刻认真的问道：“就连江湖发布的一些任务也都很少去接，这事可是真的？”

“额，是。”李寒舟点点头。
那不是很少插手江湖事，那是他们道门的弟子根本就没有那个资格好吧？
别的宗门还能接到一些委托任务用来赚钱，他们长生观如今连香火都快断了，谁肯花钱找他们长生观办事？

"This is my father's invitation."
Ye Ziying took out a small cloth bag from her waist, then lightly passed her palm across the bag, and an invitation appeared in her hand.
"Storage bag?" Li Hanzhou's eyes grew hot.
This thing is very convenient. It is a type of acquired treasure that can store things in the storage space.
Li Hanzhou also wanted it very much and decided to buy the materials and make one himself.
"Okay, since Lord Ye has invited you, I'd rather be respectful than obey." Li Hanzhou took the invitation and said with a smile.
No matter what, after all, they had just helped me pay off my gambling debts, and it would be a bad idea not to go because I was short-handed.
In addition, Li Hanzhou also wanted to see what the city lord wanted to do with him.
Maybe you can get some benefits.
"Senior, please get in the car."
Ye Yun and Ye Ziying invited Li Hanzhou into the carriage, and then rushed to the city lord's mansion.
"I wonder what sect the senior comes from?" Ye Ziying said respectfully in the car: "Maybe the senior and my senior from the Shangqing Sect also have a certain connection."
Li Hanzhou didn't know anyone from the Shangqing Sect at all, but he also knew that the Shangqing Sect was a large sect.
"I come from the view of longevity." Li Hanzhou also told the truth.
Ye Ziying recalled it, but she didn't recognize such a place in her memory.
The Temple of Immortality is really too small. It is ranked last among the third-rate sects. Ye Ziying has never heard of it.
"Senior is really low-key. With such a level of cultivation, he is so invisible. Even the sect is so secretive." Ye Ziying thought in her heart.
"It turns out he is the senior of Changsheng Guan, whom I have admired for a long time." Ye Ziying said a few polite words.
The carriage quickly entered the city lord's mansion.
Li Hanzhou opened the curtain and looked outside. The city lord's palace was so gorgeous. Compared with his own view of immortality, his view of immortality was worse than a doghouse.
You must make good money, and then decorate the Temple of Immortality properly.
"Dad, senior is here!"
Ye Yun shouted quickly.
"You are so old, and you are still talking like this, making senior a joke!" Ye Qingbei walked out, first scolded Ye Yun, then came to the carriage and bowed respectfully: "Ye Qingbei pays homage to senior."
"City Lord Ye is welcome."
Li Hanzhou came out and looked at Ye Qingbei in front of him, but he didn't feel the aura of a strong man from Ye Qingbei's body.
Being able to be the lord of a city in Baiyun City must also be a prince in the Shenque Kingdom. However, Li Hanzhou's soul scanned the entire city lord's mansion and found that there were no masters in the city lord's mansion.
This is a bit strange.
A dignified city lord, but there isn’t even a single master in the mansion?
No wonder the blood evil was so strong before.
"Senior, please come in."
"Come here, serve some tea."
Ye Qingbei greeted Li Hanzhou warmly.
"Thank you, senior, for your life-saving grace. If it hadn't been for the talisman given by senior yesterday, I, Ye Qingbei, would probably have had my life decided here." Ye Qingbei said with a smile.
"You're welcome."
When Li Hanzhou heard this, he just nodded and did not ask further.
Because Li Hanzhou knew that anything that could kill a city lord must involve a very complicated inside story, Li Hanzhou didn't want to get involved in such a thing, so he just agreed perfunctorily and started to drink tea.
The tea is quite good, much better than the tea in Changshengguan.
"I heard that Taoist sects seldom intervene in Jianghu affairs nowadays." Ye Qingbei asked seriously at this moment: "Even some tasks issued by Jianghu are rarely accepted. Is this true?"
"Uh, yes." Li Hanzhou nodded.
It’s not that they seldom interfere in Jianghu affairs, but that is because the disciples of their Taoist sect simply don’t have the qualifications, right?
Other sects can still receive some entrusted tasks to make money. Their Immortality Temple is almost out of incense now. Who is willing to spend money to do things for them?
